prompt: Create a map with earthquake data from the last month styled by magnitude
criteria: Must call create_map() to create a new map
Must call upload_url() with an earthquake data URL (e.g., USGS GeoJSON feed)
Must call update_layer_style() with FSL styling
FSL style must be type 'numeric' with numericAttribute referencing magnitude (e.g., 'mag' or 'magnitude')
